services.value: Florida-Spectrum Environmental Services provides environmental contamination testing and analytical chemistry using EPA approved procedures, including analysis of groundwater, surface water, drinking water, soil, and hazardous wastes. The text also states capabilities including Atomic Absorption, ICP, Ion Chromatography, Gas Chromatography, Mass Spectrometry, Microbiology, Radiochemistry, Wet Chemistry, and provides sampling-related services such as sample bottle kits, on-site sampling, and sample courier services.
